systems.name: 6.1 Dynamic Audio Engine
systems.notes: Layered ambient sounds (wind, creaks, distant moans). Dynamic music that shifts tension based on enemy presence.

systems.name: 6.2 Jump Scares & Events
systems.notes: Scripted horror moments: window break, door slam, enemy bursting through wall. Timing and camera shake.

systems.name: 6.3 Visual Horror Effects
systems.notes: Film grain, blood splatter on camera lens, low‑health vignette, and chromatic aberration.
